provenance.source: Handwritten 480fb1d9 bytes, register values, and literal expected state; tests/cpu/generate_stage2_cmpxchg_qword_register.py only serializes these constants. No assembler, emulator, or semantic expected-value generator.
provenance.specification: Intel SDM revision 093, Vol.2A CMPXCHG: REX.W + 0F B1 /r compares RAX with the destination; equality writes the source to the destination, otherwise the destination is copied to RAX. Arithmetic flags reflect the comparison. This local-only case is register-register only.
provenance.specification_version: Intel SDM Vol.2A revision 093 (253666-093US), CMPXCHG; project S2-21c
